description: Container images in config/containers/compose.yaml and GitHub Actions only.
flake.lock stays with the weekly update-flake-lock workflow.
Nothing with a fresh release is proposed: seven days must pass first.

packageRules.description: One weekly pull request for all images. A person reads the release notes and merges.
Bifrost releases every few days and has regressed in patch releases. Its image carries no source label, so link the notes by hand.
Actions are pinned to a commit. Small updates merge themselves once CI is green.
